home.practice_racks_blurb: Sort fuel cells between racks and ship a rack full of one kind, before the crate hanging over the row comes down. Ship back to back for a chain.
racks.title: Racks
racks.how_to: Tap a rack to lift the cells of one kind off its top, then tap another rack to set them down; any cell may sit on any other. A rack filled with one kind ships for 100. A crate of new cells hangs over one rack and comes down after the number of moves on it, on top of whatever is there. If the rack has no room for it, the crate smashes the rack: its cells are lost, and 50 points with them. Tap the crate to call it down now.
racks.how_to_keyboard: 1 to 5 lift from a rack and set down on a rack. Left and right move the cursor, space lifts and sets down, escape puts the cells back. C calls the crate.
racks.chain_note: Ship on back-to-back actions for a chain: the second rack scores double, the third triple. A crate that lands to fill its rack ships it too, so a call can be a link.
racks.hint_note: Practice rounds show an action worth taking when you pause.
